module.Title: Remove a Mined Rock
module.Teaching: The Remove method deletes the first matching value from a List.
module.PredictionQuestion: What should happen after a rock is mined?
PredictionOptions: Remove it from the rock list
module.PredictionExplanation: Removing the collected rock keeps the world state accurate.
module.DebugPrompt: List<T> uses Remove, not Delete, to remove a matching value.
module.PreviewMessage: Mined rocks can now disappear from the collection.
